reports.title: ORMAT TECHNOLOGIES REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS

guidance.heading: 2026 GUIDANCE
section: • | Total revenues are expected to be between $1,170 million and $1,200million.
◦ | Electricity segment revenues between $700 million and $710 million.
◦ | Product segment revenues of between $310 million and $320 million.
◦ | Energy Storage revenues of between $160 million and $170 million.
• | Adjusted EBITDA is expected to be between $640 million and $650 million.
◦ | Of which approximately $13.0 million is attributed to minority interest.
